question: What will be NVIDIA's forward guidance in its Q3 FY2027 earnings release? (Operating expenses (GAAP))

calls.reasoning: Anchor: CFO's full-year FY27 opex growth guide of 'low 50s' (raised from 'high 40s' in Q1). On the recast FY26 non-GAAP base of 22.82B, 50-53% growth leaves Q4 non-GAAP at 9.55-10.23B. GAAP runs about 0.2B higher, so Q4 GAAP is about 9.75-10.45B. On a GAAP basis (23.08B) it would be 9.4-10.1B. Cross-check: GAAP sequential opex growth went 12% -> 10% -> 9.4% (Q3 guide), and past Q4 guides were 6-16% above Q3 actual, giving about 9.7-10.3B. Upside risks: the full-year guide has been raised every quarter, plus acquisitions and compute costs. Downside: Q3 actual may come in under the 9.2B guide (Q2 came in at 8.41B vs the 8.5B guide). No prediction market found on Polymarket, Manifold or Kalshi.

- Q2 FY27 press release (Aug 26, 2026): Q3 FY27 outlook GAAP opex ~9.2B, non-GAAP ~9.0B; revenue 108B +/-2%; GM 74.0%.
- Actual GAAP opex: Q4 FY26 6.794B; Q1 FY27 7.621B; Q2 FY27 8.408B (+10% q/q, +55% y/y). Non-GAAP: Q1 7.449B, Q2 8.232B (gap GAAP minus non-GAAP is about 0.17-0.18B per quarter: acquisition-related costs) [press releases / stocktitan 8-K summary].
- Since Q1 FY27, non-GAAP INCLUDES stock-based compensation. Recast FY26 non-GAAP opex incl. SBC: Q1 4.993, Q2 5.361, Q3 5.800, Q4 6.666; FY 22.819B [marketscreener, NVIDIA recast release].
- FY26 GAAP opex total 23.076B; FY26 quarters GAAP: 5.030, 5.413, 5.839, 6.794 [Q4 FY26 release].
- Q2 FY27 guide for opex was GAAP 8.5B / non-GAAP 8.3B; actual came in at 8.408 / 8.232 (slightly under guide).
- Q1 FY27 call (May 20, 2026): full-year opex growth guided 'high 40s'. Q2 call (Aug 26, 2026): raised to 'low 50s', driven by a broader product portfolio and AI-tool usage (basis not explicitly stated; likely non-GAAP).
- Arithmetic: Q1 + Q2 + Q3-guide = 24.681B non-GAAP / 25.229B GAAP. Full-year growth of 50/51/52/53% on the 22.819B non-GAAP base implies Q4 non-GAAP of 9.55/9.78/10.01/10.23B. On the GAAP base (23.076B) it implies Q4 GAAP of 9.39/9.62/9.85/10.08B.
- Historical Q4 guide vs Q3 actual (GAAP): FY24 3.17 vs 2.983 (+6%); FY25 4.8 vs 4.287 (+12%); FY26 about 6.7 vs 5.839 (+15%) [recall, not re-verified this run].
- Recent GAAP sequential growth: about +12% (Q1), +10% (Q2), +9.4% implied (Q3 guide).
- Q3 FY27 ended Oct 25, 2026; results scheduled Nov 17, 2026 [Investing.com]. Consensus previews focus on revenue (~109-113B); no opex-guide consensus found.
- Resolution: resolves off the GAAP opex figure in the 'Outlook' section of the Q3 FY27 press release (the Q4 FY27 guide), rounded to 0.1B; not the non-GAAP figure, not the call commentary.
- Event window: single release expected 2026-11-17; as of 2026-11-04, the release has not occurred.
- Searched but not found: Q2 call wording specifying GAAP vs non-GAAP basis for 'low 50s'; any announced acquisitions closing in Q4 FY27 that would add opex; prediction markets (none on Polymarket, Manifold or Kalshi).

calls.reasoning: Two methods agree. (1) Guide-step trend: the GAAP opex guide went 5.9->6.7->7.7->8.5->9.2 (+0.7 to +1.0 per quarter, steps shrinking), so a Q4 guide of about 9.8-10.1. (2) Full-year statement: 'low 50s' FY27 opex growth on FY26 GAAP 23.08B gives 34.85-35.3B; minus Q1 7.62 + Q2 8.41 + Q3 ~9.15 leaves ~9.6-10.2B for Q4. Median ~9.95. Tails: a smaller step if Q3 came in light (low side); M&A/GAAP-only costs or faster compute/AI-tool spending (high side). No Polymarket/Manifold/Kalshi market found.

Guide-step trend independently gives ~9.9-10.1. I take median 10.0 with slight upside skew reflecting the non-GAAP reading and NVIDIA's history of exceeding opex growth guides (FY26 guided high-30s, delivered ~41%), offset by actuals landing under guide.
